chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub narrated from Abi 'Ali al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn 'Abd al-Jabbar, from Safwan, from Ishaq ibn 'Ammar, from Abi al-Hasan عليه السلام, who said:
I have not seen the people take from al-Hasan and al-Husayn عليهما السلام anything except the salat (prayer) after al-'asr and after al-ghadah in the tawaf of the obligatory rite.

key_terms.الصَّلَاةَ: the salat (prayer) being discussed as the ritual prayer connected to tawaf
key_terms.الْحَسَنِ وَالْحُسَيْنِ عَلَيْهِمَا السّ: Imam al-Hasan and Imam al-Husayn, whose practice is cited as the source
key_terms.طَوَافِ الْفَرِيضَةِ: the obligatory tawaf, for which the prayer is being mentioned

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform the salat of obligatory tawaf after al-'asr and after al-ghadah?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses a jurisprudential ruling concerning the two rak'ahs associated with tawaf, specifically their performance after al-'asr and after al-ghadah in the case of obligatory tawaf. It indicates that this practice was taken by the people from al-Hasan and al-Husayn عليهما السلام, highlighting its authority in ritual worship.
